connector.name: ~Alter Identity
connector.registryDescription: Identity infrastructure for the AI economy. Confirms if someone is known; returns inferred traits.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.truealter.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.truealter, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-ALTER-API-Key
headers.description: Optional member-scoped credential. Anonymous callers get L0 free tier (rate-limited).
